verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal is the `/v1/` prefix in the documented endpoint URL (POST https://api.beglaubigt.de/v1/trade-registration), so the API is path-versioned. Nothing in the docs or the llms.txt index describes a versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning and changelog documentation, backward-compatibility guarantees, and independent corroboration.
